messages.text: Hey  guys, I would like to file an RMA and I already sent a mail to (email hidden) yesterday or the day before...with a descibtion and pictures of the issue. No answer so far ...can someone help me out what to do now..or just wait a few more days?
Used the customer-care skill
Used the store-orders skill

Sorry about the faulty unit. Don't wait on that mail, RMA only gets logged through the intake form, and that's what generates your return label:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Attach the same photos and description there. Processing takes up to 10 days once the unit reaches the warehouse. One thing to note: overclocked or modified units aren't covered.

Was the unit ever overclocked, and what's your order number? I can check the order while you fill it in.
Shop····  The device was never overclocked. I did change the stock fans indeed with the Nocua models becuase the stock ones were to noisy. The order number is Shop····
Used the store-orders skill
Handed to the team · warranty coverage call on a user-modified unit; terms being reconciled, not mine

Thanks. Never overclocked is good, but swapping the stock fans counts as a modification, and modified units sit outside the standard RMA cover. I'm not going to guess on yours, so I've put it in front of the team to confirm before you ship anything back. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here shortly; if you step away, the answer comes by email.

What's the email on the order? I'll pull Shop···· up in the meantime.
(email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill

Got it, the order's up. The NerdQX that went to (address hidden) was delivered August 8, so that's the unit the RMA covers. Put those same photos in the form so the label gets generated, but hold off actually posting the unit until the team confirms the fan swap.

One other thing on this order: the second NerdQX and the Overclocking Bundle still show as not shipped, and part of the order was refunded at some point. Are you still waiting on those two?
even the issue has nothing to do with the fans?

Fair point, and you may well be right. I just can't be the one to call it, because the blanket rule here is that modified units fall outside cover, and whether a fan swap on an unrelated fault is an exception is the team's call, not mine. That's exactly what I've put to them, so it gets looked at properly rather than refused by default.

While we wait: what's the unit actually doing? A hashrate drop, no boot, error on screen?
as soon as it builds up Hashrate it sayss Volttage Protection #···· or VREG Overheated #···· . The L. file says it is a faulty TPS536X7 chip.

That's the VRM controller on the hashboard, the power stage. Not something a fan swap touches, and I've added it to the note for the team, it helps your case.

Worth ruling out one thing first: a PSU that sags once the hashboard pulls full load throws those exact two errors. Are you on the stock PSU, and what voltage does the dashboard show at the moment it trips? If it dips there, it's the PSU, and that's a much faster fix than sending the whole unit back.
the input voltage ist 12,5V there is not drop on the input. Yes I use the PSU that came with the NerdQX

Then the PSU's clean and it's the board. Stable 12.5V in with the stock supply, and the log naming the TPS536x7, that's a hardware fault on the unit.

Go ahead and file the form now with the photos and that log, and put the 12.5V reading and stock PSU in the description. It gets the RMA in the queue. Just don't post the unit until the team comes back on the fan swap, which lands here in the chat or in your inbox.
okay I'll fill out the form and wait.

Sounds good. Once the label's issued and the unit lands at the warehouse, processing runs up to 10 days.

Still open on my side: the second NerdQX and the Overclocking Bundle on this order have never shipped, and July 11 has long passed. Are you still expecting those, or were they part of the refund? Tell me either way and I'll sort it out with you now rather than leave it sitting.
there was no second NerdQX. and I canceled the order of the overclocking bundle because It took too long to deliver

Understood, that matches the refund on the order. So this one's just the delivered NerdQX and the RMA on it, nothing outstanding to ship.

I've corrected the note to the team so nobody comes back to you about a bundle you already cancelled. Fill in the form when you get a minute, and the answer on the fan swap reaches you here or by email. Anything else on it, just say.
Email would be better. Nothing else thank you. I'll try to get my hands on The Harlo H15 Dual, but that is nothing you can help me with.
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual

Noted, the answer will come to (email hidden), and a copy of this whole chat lands there too once we're done.

On the H15 Dual, we don't list it, so I can't quote you a price or a date on it. If you want, I'll ask the team whether it's coming and have them include it in the same email. Otherwise, good luck with the RMA, and thanks for being straight about the fans.
one more thing. in the form I could not upload pictures or a sceenshot of the log.

That's fine, the form doesn't take attachments. Submit it without them, describe the two errors and the TPS536X7 line from the log in the text, and reference the order number.

Then when the team's email reaches you, reply to that mail with the photos and the log screenshot attached. It goes straight onto the case, and you've already sent them once anyway, so nothing is lost.
ok good. Bye and Thanks to the team
Will pass that on. Get the form in when you can, and keep an eye on your inbox for the fan swap answer and the transcript. All the best with it.
